name: uWSGI stats server reachable
description: Returns `CRITICAL` if the Agent cannot connect to, read, or parse the uWSGI stats server for an instance; `OK` otherwise.

name: uWSGI worker saturation
description: Returns `WARNING` or `CRITICAL` as the socket listen queue fills (queue/max_queue crosses the configured thresholds) or all non-cheap workers are busy with a growing listen queue; `OK` otherwise.
